wiki.title: Stuart Adams
wiki.extract: Jabez Stuart Adams (born 1954/1955) is the Republican senator for the Utah State Senate's 7th District. Prior to redistricting, he represented the 22nd District. Adams was appointed to the Utah House of Representatives in 2002 and then to the Senate in 2009. In 2012, he was chosen to be the Senate majority whip. In 2018, he was chosen to be Senate president.
